hook: Put the same unit back in the fire every turn until it's a burning carry that keeps coming back.
loop: Reforge a few pieces: +1/+1, a Heat and a burn.
Heat piles up permanently on a few hot units.
Cash Heat into Shield, Cleave, Swoop, Attack or extra lives.

growth.line: +1/+1 per Reforge early; Heat payoffs and the Tier 6 Furnace make the hottest unit snowball late.

feel.early: One newt, heated every turn, small clicks.
feel.mid: Heat piles up; burn or heal, cash out or keep.
feel.late: Furnace, Nutrisco or Ottilie turn it loose.

stars.why: Burn your own board on purpose for Attack and comebacks.
Hot units come back stronger, each comeback a bit weaker.
Gives Heat clear goals: Shield, then Cleave, then Swoop.

card_short.u01: Regrow. Reforges itself every End of Turn.
card_short.u02: When played: Reforge another friendly unit.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: spends gold to Reforge your hottest unit.
card_short.u04: Gains Attack for each damage on it.
card_short.u05: When played: fully heal a unit; healing becomes permanent stats.
card_short.u06: Each sale Reforges your hottest unit twice.
card_short.u07: Start of Combat: damages your own units; damaged ones gain Attack.
card_short.u08: When played: cash a unit's Heat into permanent stats.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: pings enemies once per your hottest unit's Heat.
card_short.u10: Your first 3 Reforges each turn happen twice.
card_short.u11: Sell a unit: its Heat goes to his right-hand neighbour.
card_short.u12: End of Turn, last: heals everyone; healed damage becomes Health.
card_short.u13: Start of Combat: each unit gains Attack per Heat.
card_short.u14: Heat goals: Shield at 4, Cleave at 8, Swoop at 16.
card_short.u15: When a unit Regrows, its neighbours gain Attack.
card_short.u16: End of Turn: Reforges every other friendly unit.
card_short.u17: Regrow; gives Regrow at 5+ Heat; Regrows give permanent stats.
card_short.u18: Reforges give more the hotter the unit already is.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: hottest unit grows per Heat, per empty slot.
card_short.x01: Reforge only while recruiting; fight damage is ordinary damage.
card_short.x02: Two-Tongs repeats don't count towards its 3.
card_short.x03: Regrow halves Heat, so units can drop below thresholds.
card_short.x04: Sold units lose Heat, except Birds away on Fly South.

builds.name: One Hot Piece
builds.line: Pour every Reforge into one carry; swap carries with Konrad.

builds.name: Burn to Rise
builds.line: Ember-Belly kills a burnt unit; Ottilie brings it back stronger.

builds.name: The Whole Forge
builds.line: Paracel heats the whole board: wide, slow, very hard to kill.

liked: All three loved Ember-Belly Newt: hurting your own board on purpose.
Real choices: cash Heat or keep it, heal burns or stay burnt.
worries: Burn to Rise needs two Ember-Bellies: Reforge's +1 Health offsets its Scorch.
Watch: Furnace, Nutrisco, Fumarole Spitter scale wildly with Heat; Konrad copies Heat with Birds.
changed: Bellows-Boy now always spends what gold it can, up to 2.
Only one Two-Tongs counts; Wet Cellar Keeper always heals last.
Burn to Rise named as a build; Furnace got a worked example.
verdict: Players chasing Heat goals and comebacks reforge one unit every turn into a burning carry.
